Team,

Quick reminder: please submit your final forecast updates for this week by Tuesday EOD PST (11/17). We're locking the Q4 commit list on Wednesday so I need:

- Stage updates for any deals moving into Commit (H=commit) or Closed-Won this week
- Any deals you want to force into or out of the commit bucket with a one-line rationale
- Updated close dates and next-step (PO, legal redlines, signature)

I've attached the RevOps agenda and the commit matrix template. Wed 11/18 11:00-11:30 PT will be our short commit review — agenda below.

Agenda (30 min):
1) Quick scoreboard and delta (5 min)
2) Deals moving to commit — 2 min each
3) Risk flags & blockers (10 min)
4) Re-prioritization / cross-team ask (5 min)

Attachments: revops_agenda_v2.pdf, Q4_commit_matrix.xlsx
